info.title: Raising Talents API
info.description: Generated from @rt/contracts. Errors use RFC 9457 problem details; choose behaviour by the `code` field, never the message.

tags.name: Auth (web)
tags.description: The same flows for browsers. Calls must come from an allowed Origin and send credentials

tags.name: Search
tags.description: Finding talent. Only complete, active profiles are indexed

tags.name: Media
tags.description: Uploads, processing and scanning. Nothing is visible before it passes the scan

tags.name: Portfolio
tags.description: Ordered images and videos on a talent profile. Others see ready media only

tags.name: Moderation
tags.description: Staff tools. Every decision is recorded with who made it

tags.name: Shortlist
tags.description: Talent an agent saved, with private notes. Talent are never told

tags.name: Messaging
tags.description: Contact requests and chat. Only verified agents can ask; chat opens when the talent accepts

tags.name: Safety
tags.description: Reports from members. Reporters stay anonymous to the reported person

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Calls from outside services. Not for the app
